author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Police seized First VPN in a global crackdown, exposed its cybercrime users, and shut down infrastructure tied to ransomware and data theft. title: Global law enforcement operation takes First VPN offline

author: Pierluigi Paganini

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Attackers bypassed MFA on patched SonicWall Gen6 VPNs because admins missed extra manual steps required to fully fix the flaw. title: Attackers are bypassing MFA on SonicWall VPNs because something was wrong with previous fix

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Cisco fixed a critical Secure Workload flaw (CVE-2026-20223) that could let attackers gain Site Admin privileges through crafted API requests. The flaw stems from insufficient validation and authentication in REST API endpoints. According to Cisco, remote attackers could […]
title: Cisco fixed maximum severity flaw CVE-2026-20223 in Secure Workload

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Discord now enables end-to-end encryption by default for all voice and video calls, making conversations inaccessible even to the platform itself. title: Discord adds end-to-end encryption to voice and video calls by default
